notes.title: 🚀 Exotic Matter Update: Improvements are Here! 🚀
notes.content:
Hello, fellow cosmic explorers and pixelated pioneers! We know it's been a while since our last update, and we owe you an apology for the radio silence and a galaxy-sized thanks for your patience. We've been quietly tinkering away in the depths of the MobiusCode studio in the past few weeks, fuelled by passion, a touch of sci-fi magic, and the camaraderie of our team and you; both existing fans and recent wishlisters, and we've addressed a few smaller things to restart the development of the game.

Now, let's dive straight into what's new: 



🛠️ Patched for a Smoother Space Odyssey 🛠️
Our intrepid team has been wielding their digital toolkit to fix some pesky space-time wrinkles. The engine has been updated; say goodbye to the mysterious "Crash on Leave Planet Button" glitch! You can now drift through the cosmos without worry, safe in the knowledge that the exit button will behave itself.

🏊 Refined Swimming Mechanics 🏊
One of the highly requested improvements has been to give the aquatic elements a tune-up. Swimming now requires you to "Hold Jump" instead of frenzied button mashing.

🎥 Lights, Camera... Less Camera Jaunt Action! 🎬
Ever felt like the camera had a mind of its own after opening inventory UIs? We've quelled that rebellious spirit - now, when you close the menu, the camera movement behaves itself, providing a more seamless transition back to where you were.

📥 Effortless Loot Gathering 📥
No more inventory-related acrobatics! We’ve introduced a nifty "Hotkey for Take All button" (X) to accompany the button that’s in the UI.

📜 Reading at Your Speed 📜
We've tinkered with the "Text Speed Setting" for your reading preferences. You can now choose from a 1-10 scale, so you can sip your space-age tea while enjoying the storyline at your own rhythm or rapidly absorb the texts if you prefer a lightspeed-read.

🌌 MobiusCode Updates 🌌
The intro video and updated credits have been woven into the fabric of Exotic Matter as we have rebranded into MobiusCode after establishing our GmbH (some sort of terra-based German company thing).



Why the Silence?

You might be wondering why it's been a cosmic age since our last update. We owe you an apology for the long pause in communication there - our studio is a small team, and we're not just space explorers; our focus on B2B clients fuels our game development. While Exotic Matter was put on the backburner, we received funds from the German government during COVID times to start working on another title - Panic Mode, along with expanding our team. Since then we're back to using our software development funds, and we're aiming to devote more time towards bringing things out of Early Access.

There’s more to the story – we hit some interstellar bumps along the way, encountering the gravitational forces of burnout and the need for a well-deserved breather. Crafting universes takes its toll, and we wanted to ensure our creative engines were roaring at full force before we ventured back into the cosmos of Exotic Matter. It’s been a suitably refreshing pause and it feels like the right time to return to Xcylin, we’re hoping that you’ll join us there.

We're deeply grateful for your support, feedback, and time you've invested thus far. Our roadmap is being built around your thoughts (along with some new ideas from our team) and we’re hopeful that those elements will bring new energy to the experience. We'd love to hear from you about all of these things (complaints, ideas, thoughts) on our Discord

(Note – the game is still in Early Access so more changes are incoming - expect the galactic roadmap to be shared soon and will be subject to change based off new feedback too)

Keep exploring, keep crafting, and keep the cosmic curiosity alive!

Safe travels,
The MobiusCode Team

notes.title: Exotic Matter's second Update: "New Beginnings" is now live!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30998581/bb83206198d60798da671fcbd69595daafc1cbab.jpg

Hello everyone!

We’re happy to announce the release of Exotic Matter’s second content update: New Beginnings! It is available for download now (you may need to restart Steam). 

Following a ton of fantastic playtesting experiences and feedback from players at Gamescom (a big thanks to you!), the team at Moebiusgames has completely revamped the opening minutes of the game and the game’s balancing. This includes:

 Largely redesigned Criterion (includes a faster ‘way out’ and more loot)
 Criterion opening segment completely redesigned to train players in all mechanics including crafting
 Criterion opening segment completely redesigned to make the player’s goal clear for the entire game
 Added hidden (and not so hidden) side locations all over the planet!
 Improved weapon balancing – player can create better weapons more quickly and the basic weapons, including the drill, now do very minor damage
 Improved enemy balancing: enemy health and properties improved
 Improved UI handling: right click in a container UI will now directly move the item to the inventory (and back!)


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30998581/bcdac30e8d4aa5c6c8997071cf6cfb5ffeb85bd8.jpg

You can keep track of our detailed road map on Trello, but for the next 2 months our main priority is:

 New dungeons! 
 New NPCs!
 A new, built from the ground-up UI system (the current one is a Java plug-in that causes issues for many users)


Our next update is planned for 28 September. Watch this space for more details!

Please post on the Steam forums if you encounter any issues or have any questions. Or join us on Discord.

Thanks for all your support and for reading!
The Moebiusgames Team

notes.title: Breaking the Ice Update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30998581/28dc65b41c5fe82f2359d54a59dce0d9bfd32f09.jpg

Hello everyone!

We’re happy to announce the release of Exotic Matter’s first content update: Breaking the Ice! It is available for download now (you may need to restart Steam). 

For this update, the team at Moebiusgames focused on making a handful of tweaks, improvements and additions that would help first time players and streamline Exotic Matter’s opening minutes. These include:

 Redesigned nanochamber (first room): players can only proceed once they receive the first objective waypoint, opening the story direction
 Redesigned tutorial flow: Players can only leave the first room once they find and use the emergency drill
 General redesigns of the Criterion (shipwreck): players no longer have to complete all side rooms to proceed and can access the open world more quickly
 A new hint/tutorial system that will help first-timers understand how to play the game
 Keybinding functionality


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30998581/8f622f50d160d0405165491dc824e7bd80da1dee.png

Future updates will include:

 New locations!
 New systems!
 New NPCs! 
 

Our next update is planned for 17 August, immediately before Gamescom 2018. Watch this space for more details!

Please post on the Steam forums if you encounter any issues or have any questions. Or join us on 
Discord.

Thanks for all your support and for reading!
The Moebiusgames Team

notes.title: Announcing Exotic Matter's first Update: "Breaking the Ice"
notes.content:
After carefully observing first-time players approach Exotic Matter, we will add more means to help players get immersed in the game. We plan to do this by:


 reworking some parts of the ship to make sure the players understand crucial mechanics before allowing them to progress

 ensuring that everyone will find the Emergency Drill, so that it is not possible to get stuck

 ensuring that everyone unlocks the first waypoint, so that it is not possible to have no direction

 adding more hints that will be displayed when certain interaction with blocks or items are possible


This update is scheduled to release on 27 July 2018. Meanwhile, hotfix updates will be released to fix any critical bugs.

You can follow the progress of this update (and all future updates) on our 
public Trello board.
